messages:
maya: heads up — ran into a parity problem between the JS SDK and the REST API for chat.function_call. SDK returns 400, REST returns the generated function call.

alex: oof. can you paste a minimal repro? which SDK version?

maya: repro using v0.8.0. tiny example:

maya: ```bash
# REST (works)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"call weather"}],"function_call":"auto"}'
```

maya: ```js
// SDK (throws 400)
await client.chat.create({
  model: 'gpt-4o-mini',
  messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'call weather'}],
  function_call: 'auto' // -> SDK serializes as `functionCall` incorrectly
})
```

sam: that looks like a param name mapping bug — our REST expects `function_call` (snake_case) for the server-side parser, but SDK is sending camelCase.

alex: hmm we intentionally have mapping layers but maybe we missed this endpoint. Is it only `function_call`? any other params?

maya: also saw `response_format`/`structured_output` drift for embeddings sample app — different default in SDK vs REST. onboarding sample app used SDK so devs thought server supported that param.

jon: two separate DX issues then: 1) param-name drift (snake vs camel) 2) default behavior mismatch for some flags. both can cause silent differences.

sam: quick triage — @alex can you confirm SDK serialization for chat payloads? if we have tests that compare SDK payload -> server schema we should catch this.

alex: checking now. I can reproduce the camelCase -> server 400. file a small failing unit test, but short-term workaround: call REST directly with raw fetch or pass rawBody via SDK.

maya: added a minimal reproduction gist: https://gist.github.com/maya/abcd1234 — includes curl + sdk snippet + server error log: `unexpected param: functionCall`

devex-bot: New issue created #4127: "SDK chat param serialization mismatch: function_call vs functionCall" assigned to @alex. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INFR-4127

alex: thanks — plan: patch serializer to preserve snake_case for known server params, add contract tests that diff REST payload vs SDK payloads for all chat options. will target patch for v0.8.1.

sam: quick note on retries: noticed SDK auto-retry logic marks chat.create as idempotent incorrectly when streaming=false — causes duplicated calls in some customers. should be a separate ticket but related to parity.

jon: agree. putting retry behavior on the checklist for parity tests. also update sample app docs to call REST if you need current behavior until SDK patch ships.

maya: confirmed workaround works. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:

alex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/876 — fixes snake_case mapping + adds contract test. cc @devex for docs change.

devex-bot: CI passed for PR 876. Deployed branch build to staging.

alex: will cut v0.8.1 tomorrow morning with the fix and release notes calling out parameter name parity and retry behavior differences.

maya: awesome. leaving this thread here for context for the sample app maintainers. :raised_hands:
